vres_not_found: Result not found in this workspace. It may have been deleted by run retention.
vres_banner_reduced: Approved with {count} checks turned off in this run
vres_banner_reduced_one: Approved with 1 check turned off in this run
vres_banner_reduced_text: This approval is reduced: it does not count as the full approval. See what was turned off below.
vres_banner_failed_text: {count} points to take care of before approving.
vres_banner_failed_one: 1 point to take care of before approving.
vres_banner_incomplete_text: There was not enough proof to approve: some required check did not finish or could not prove what it needed.
vres_banner_invalid_text: The configuration or the contract could not be resolved, so there is no decision.
vres_partial_text: The run was interrupted before finishing. The report below is partial: it shows only what was done so far.
vres_crashed_text: The run process died before writing the final result. The report below is partial.
vres_complete_no: Result not complete: some required checks have no proof.
vres_copy_agent_done: Context copied. Nothing was sent: paste it wherever you like.
vres_copy_agent_manual: Could not copy automatically. The text is below for you to copy.
vres_copy_agent_hint: Safe summary: an instruction not to change the criteria, delimited data and the reproduction command. Sends nothing.
vres_folder_unavailable: Could not open the folder from here. Path: {path}
vres_link_open: See the link to the code and the configuration
vres_link_title: Link to the code and the configuration
vres_link_none: This result does not record the link.
vres_cause_dependency: Depends on a stage that did not finish well
vres_cache_why: Reason: the inputs of this stage have not changed since then.
vres_metrics_empty: No metric was measured in this run.
vres_architecture_text: What the dependency extractor managed to see. A partial or empty graph does not prove the absence of violations.
vres_architecture_verified: Verified: the absence of findings is the absence of violations.
vres_architecture_unverified: Not verified: the absence of findings does not prove the absence of violations.
vres_disabled: What was turned off and where
vres_workspace_files: Files the validation left in the workspace
vres_workspace_files_none: The validation left no file in the workspace.
vres_workspace_files_not_checked: The workspace files were not checked in this run.
vres_policy_change: Policy compared to the previous run
vres_policy_changed: The policy changed since the previous run ({runId}). Approvals of the two runs are not comparable.
vres_policy_same: The policy is the same as in the previous run ({runId}).
vres_policy_not_comparable: There is no way to compare the policy with the previous run ({runId}).
vres_policy_first: This is the first complete run of this workspace.
vres_baseline_warning_POLICY_CHANGED: The policy changed since the baseline.
vres_baseline_warning_RULES_CHANGED: The rules changed since the baseline.
vres_baseline_warning_SCOPE_CHANGED: The scope changed since the baseline.
vres_baseline_warning_REDUCED_RUN: One of the two runs was reduced.
vres_baseline_warning_BASELINE_PARTIAL: The baseline is from a partial run.
